title: Recording: Mind Games by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The eighth and final day of overdubs for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 20 August 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. The overdubs recorded on this day are not known, but the session ran until early the following morning.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.

Page last updated: 13 February 2025
